note: the historic network, resolved from the Board's own route descriptions onto DataSF street centrelines. Geometry is TODAY'S streets; the SELECTION and the DATE are the record's.

routes.name: Church street line (J)
routes.quote: For construction of Church street line, from Market street and Van Ness avenue to Sixteenth and Church streets, Section "A", Contract No. 23

routes.name: Twin Peaks tunnel line, Taraval extension (L)
routes.quote: Ordinance No. 4527 (New Series), approved by the Mayor September 25, 1917, providing for the construction of a line from the southwesterly portal of the Twin Peaks tunnel over Ulloa street, Fifteenth avenue and Taraval street to Twentieth avenue

routes.name: Geary Street Municipal Railway, Richmond extension
routes.quote: J. R. No. 307. Resolved, That the Board of Public Works, be and it is hereby authorized and directed to advertise for bids for track construction for the Geary Street Municipal Railway from Geary street along Thirty-third avenue, Balboa street, Forty-fifth avenue and Cabrillo street to the Great Highway, and when bids shall have been received the Finance Committee will recommend the necessary appropriation.

routes.name: Market Street Railway, Bryant and Sterling
routes.quote: Bill No. 710, Ordinance No. 15.0918: Authorizing Market Street Railway Company to abandon and discontinue street car service and remove its street railway tracks from Bryant Street from Second Street to Sterling Street, thence along Sterling Street to Harrison Street

routes.name: Market Street Railway, Harrison Street
routes.quote: to abandon and discontinue street car service and remove its street railway tracks from Harrison Street, commencing at the intersection of Second and Harrison Streets, thence along Harrison Street to Steuart Street

routes.name: Market Street Railway, Steuart Street
routes.quote: and on Steuart Street from Harrison Street to Folsom Street
